annotations.title: Parse an Altium Designer ASCII footprint export

description: Parse an Altium Designer ASCII footprint export (a text file — NOT a binary .PcbLib/.SchLib) and extract the footprint name, per-pad copper geometry (designator, name, coordinates, size, shape), layer map, and this module's own review/audit verdict. This reads an EXISTING Altium file; it does not build one from a datasheet PDF (for that, see the Altium Assist output pack on a completed extraction job). No model call — deterministic parsing only.

documentPath.description: https:// URL to an Altium ASCII footprint export (a text file, not a binary .PcbLib/.SchLib). The remote /api/mcp endpoint accepts ONLY https:// URLs (it downloads them); a local filesystem path works solely in local stdio mode (npm run mcp:serve)..

name: datasheetvend_extract_altium_bundle

delivery_status.description: The module's own audit verdict for this file — the same one a REST/dashboard job would carry.

footprints_detected.description: How many footprint blocks the file contained. Only one (the best match) is returned above.

manufacturer_part_number.description: The partName you sent, or the component name text found in the file — never the footprint's own name.

other_footprint_names.description: Names of the OTHER footprints in the file, not returned above — nothing is silently dropped.

height.description: Pad copper height, exactly as written in the source file — see units. Never converted.

width.description: Pad copper width, exactly as written in the source file — see units. Never converted.

x.description: Pad center X, exactly as written in the source file — see units. Never converted.

y.description: Pad center Y, exactly as written in the source file — see units. Never converted.

source_format_detected.description: line_block_ascii is the only format this tool actually reads.

status.description: FAILED means the credits for this call are refunded automatically: the file was unreadable, a recognized-but-unsupported format, or contained no footprint.

units.description: Coordinate/size units exactly as the source file stated them. Values are NEVER converted — 'unknown' means the file did not state a unit, not that the numbers are millimetres.

title: Parse an Altium Designer ASCII footprint export
